scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,front -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:front"
scripts.dev:mainnet: concurrently -n api,front -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api:mainnet" "npm run dev:front:mainnet"
scripts.dev:testnet: concurrently -n api,front -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:api:testnet" "npm run dev:front:testnet"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build --workspace=@bnb-marketplace/shared-types && npm run dev --workspace=@bnb-marketplace/api
scripts.dev:api:mainnet: npm run build --workspace=@bnb-marketplace/shared-types && npm run dev:mainnet --workspace=@bnb-marketplace/api
scripts.dev:api:testnet: npm run build --workspace=@bnb-marketplace/shared-types && npm run dev:testnet --workspace=@bnb-marketplace/api
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@bnb-marketplace/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@bnb-marketplace/api && npm run build --workspace=agent-market-frontend
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:up && npm run db:migrate
